name: Exp_XHullTigit
summary: This EA trades based on the XHullTrend Digit indicator, which uses a Hull Moving Average derivative to determine trend direction and generates discrete buy/sell signals. It enters long when the Hull Trend turns bullish and short when it turns bearish, with customizable position management. The system is a fully automated trend-following strategy that relies on smoothed trend detection for trade decisions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于XHullTrend Digit指标进行交易，该指标使用Hull均线衍生算法判断趋势方向并生成离散的买卖信号。当Hull趋势转为看涨时做多，转为看跌时做空，并具有可自定义的仓位管理功能。这是一个完全自动化的趋势跟踪策略，依赖平滑趋势检测来做出交易决策。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Hull移动平均线的趋势跟踪系统，Hull均线通过加权移动平均的差值来减少滞后性并提供更平滑的趋势判断。入场条件为：当XHullTrend Digit指标由下跌转为上涨（颜色变化或数值翻转）时开多单，由上涨转为下跌时开空单。出场条件通常包括反向信号出现时平仓、止损止盈触发平仓、或尾随止损平仓。仓位管理方面，EA支持固定手数交易，可能还支持基于账户余额百分比的动态仓位计算。资金管理方面，通过止损设置控制单笔风险，但没有复杂的资金管理或风险分散机制。整体策略属于典型的单指标趋势跟踪，逻辑简单直接，依赖趋势的持续性获利。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a Hull Moving Average trend-following system, where the Hull MA reduces lag through weighted average differencing to provide smoother trend identification. Entry conditions: open a long position when the XHullTrend Digit indicator shifts from bearish to bullish (color change or value flip), and open a short position when it shifts from bullish to bearish. Exit conditions typically include closing on a reverse signal, stop-loss or take-profit being hit, or a trailing stop activation. Position sizing supports fixed lot trading and may include dynamic lot calculation based on account balance percentage. Money management controls per-trade risk through stop-loss settings but lacks complex capital allocation or risk diversification mechanisms. The overall strategy is a typical single-indicator trend-following approach with simple and direct logic, relying on trend persistence for profitability.

parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: Trailing_Stop

parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

parameters.description_en: Hull MA period, 0 for indicator default

parameters.name: Position_Check
parameters.description: 是否检查已有持仓避免重复开仓
parameters.description_en: Check existing positions to avoid duplicate entries

pros: 基于Hull均线的趋势判断滞后性较小，信号响应较快
策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和参数优化
完全自动化执行，无需人工干预，适合趋势行情
可配置止损止盈和尾随止损，具备基本风险控制
pros_en: Hull MA-based trend detection has minimal lag and faster signal response
Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and optimize parameters
Fully automated execution without manual intervention, suitable for trending markets
Configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and trailing stop provide basic risk control
cons: 单指标策略在震荡行情中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
缺乏多时间周期确认和过滤机制，容易在低级别噪音中被误导
没有内置的资金管理模块，固定手数无法根据市场波动自适应调整
Hull均线在趋势转折点附近可能出现反复翻转导致来回开平仓
cons_en: Single-indicator strategy prone to frequent false signals and consecutive losses in ranging markets
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation and filtering, easily misled by low-level noise
No built-in money management module; fixed lots cannot adapt to market volatility dynamically
Hull MA may flip repeatedly near trend turning points causing repeated open/close cycles
improvements: 增加多时间周期趋势过滤，例如大周期Hull趋势方向一致时才允许交易
加入ATR-based动态止损和仓位计算，根据市场波动性自适应调整风险参数
增加震荡市过滤机制，如ADX阈值或波动率收缩判断，避免在非趋势行情中频繁交易
improvements_en: Add multi-timeframe trend filtering, only allowing trades when higher-timeframe Hull trend direction aligns
Implement ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and position sizing to adapt risk parameters to market volatility
Add ranging market filter such as ADX threshold or volatility contraction detection to avoid frequent trading in non-trending conditions

risk_points: 单指标趋势策略在震荡市中连续亏损风险较高
缺乏高级资金管理模块，无法动态控制风险敞口
如果止损设为0则存在无限亏损的理论可能
risk_points_en: Single-indicator trend strategy has high risk of consecutive losses in ranging markets
Lacks advanced money management module, cannot dynamically control risk exposure
If stop-loss is set to 0, theoretically unlimited loss is possible
